subtalents.name: Balance
subtalents.effect: Reduces the Battle Weight of Sword and Dagger weapons by up to SR * 1.5.

modifiers.subject: Battle Weight of Sword and Dagger weapons

subtalents.name: Adaptation
subtalents.effect: Allows you to equip any Sword weapon with a Rarity equal to or less than SR * 2.

subtalents.name: Reliability
subtalents.effect: For Sword and Dagger weapons: increases Hit by SR * 1.5 and reduces Durability consumption by SR * 5%.

subtalents.name: Balance
subtalents.effect: Reduces the Battle Weight of Axe weapons by up to SR * 1.5.

subtalents.name: Adaptation
subtalents.effect: Allows you to equip any Axe weapon with a Rarity equal to or less than SR * 2.

subtalents.name: Deadliness
subtalents.effect: For Axe weapons: increases Critical by SR * 1.5 and Critical Damage by SR * 0.5%.

subtalents.name: Balance
subtalents.effect: Reduces the Battle Weight of Polearm weapons by up to SR * 1.5.

subtalents.name: Adaptation
subtalents.effect: Allows you to equip any Polearm weapon with a Rarity equal to or less than SR * 2.

subtalents.name: Thin Tip
subtalents.effect: For Polearm weapons: increases Power by SR * 1.5 when attacking an enemy in melee range who is facing you.

subtalents.name: Balance
subtalents.effect: Reduces the Battle Weight of Bow weapons by up to SR * 1.5.

subtalents.name: Adaptation
subtalents.effect: Allows you to equip any Bow weapon with a Rarity equal to or less than SR * 2.

subtalents.name: Close Shot
subtalents.effect: For Bow weapons: decreases the close-range Hit penalty by SR * 5%. Doubled for Shortbows.

subtalents.name: Balance
subtalents.effect: Reduces the Battle Weight of Fist weapons by up to SR * 1.5.

subtalents.name: Adaptation
subtalents.effect: Allows you to equip any Fist weapon with a Rarity equal to or less than SR * 2.

subtalents.name: Dizzy
subtalents.effect: For Fist weapons: attacks that hit reduce the target's FP by SR * 1. 50% effective versus Light Armor and 25% effective against Heavy Armor.

subtalents.name: Balance
subtalents.effect: Reduces the Battle Weight of Gun weapons by up to SR * 1.5.

subtalents.name: Volley
subtalents.effect: For Bow and Gun weapons: increases attack range by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Wind Read
subtalents.effect: Increases maximum range before Farshot Penalty is applied by SR * 1.

modifiers.subject: maximum range before Farshot Penalty is applied

subtalents.name: Adaptation
subtalents.effect: Allows you to equip any Gun weapon with a Rarity equal to or less than SR * 2.

subtalents.name: Self-Service
subtalents.effect: After every battle, restores equipped weapon Durability by SR * 1, up to 75% maximum. If two weapons are equipped, half the effect applies to both if the secondary weapon has Durability damage.

subtalents.name: Squad-Service
subtalents.effect: All other party members receive your Self-Service at SR * 20% of its usual effectiveness. Only the highest Squad-Service in the party applies.

subtalents.name: Mastery
subtalents.effect: Increases the maximum Durability that Maintenance effects can repair to by SR * 3% (90% at SR 5).

subtalents.name: Emergency Service
subtalents.effect: Grants a battle skill targeting someone with broken weapons. It consumes 2 Murai and restores each broken weapon's Durability to SR * 1; 5-round cooldown.

subtalents.name: Hayasa
subtalents.effect: Using Swap Weapon to equip a Shuriken refunds up to 3 Momentum, but puts Swap Weapon on a 1-round cooldown.

subtalents.name: Endan
subtalents.effect: Bomb items also explode into Smokescreen tiles with LV SR * 5 that last for 2 + SR rounds.

subtalents.name: Kagero
subtalents.effect: You and your allies ignore the effects of your Smokescreen tiles.

subtalents.name: Yobai
subtalents.effect: While Airborne, the attack range of your Shuriken weapons increases by SR * 1.

modifiers.subject: attack range of your Shuriken weapons

subtalents.name: Danmaku
subtalents.effect: Once per round, with a Shuriken equipped, dodging an attack or triggering Evasion hits all enemies within 3 Range with weak versions, dealing protection-ignoring damage equal to the weapon's Power + SR * 3.

subtalents.name: Health
subtalents.effect: Every 15 out-of-combat steps, if below 75% maximum HP, restore SR * 1 HP.

subtalents.name: Stamina
subtalents.effect: Increases Physical Stamina recovered every hour by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Jump
subtalents.effect: Reduces the Stamina cost of using upward Jump Spots by 1.

subtalents.name: Experience
subtalents.effect: Increases battle EXP gained for the entire party by SR * 2%. Only the highest Experience in the party applies.

subtalents.name: Training
subtalents.effect: Lets you train certain NPCs and other characters. EXP gained increases with SR by 2.5% of EXP required to level per SR.

subtalents.name: Tools
subtalents.effect: Lets you set up Training Tools at certain locations; higher SR improves EXP gained by 2% of EXP required to level per SR.

subtalents.name: Will
subtalents.effect: Grants resistance to Fear by SR * 16% (minimum 0-1 Hit) and reduces Fear of Death duration by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Determination
subtalents.effect: Grants resistance to Hesitation equal to SR * 15%.

subtalents.name: Heat of Battle
subtalents.effect: Away from the battlefield edge, Power increases by SR * 1 and Physical and Magical Defense versus monsters increase by SR * 1%. Bonuses are doubled if the enemy is at the battlefield edge.

subtalents.name: Take Prisoner
subtalents.effect: Grants Capture: a 1-Range attack with Hit and damage penalties that captures an enemy if it reduces them to 0 HP. Maximum prisoners: SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Restrain
subtalents.effect: Grants Grapple, inflicting Immobilize on you and a target within 1 Range on success. Success is SR * 17% plus 2% per character level you exceed the target by.

subtalents.name: Convert
subtalents.effect: Lets you convert captured monsters into mercenaries for a Murai fee. Success is SR * 20%; failure requires waiting 3 in-game hours.

subtalents.name: Seize
subtalents.effect: If prisoner space is available, gives an SR * 1% chance to capture defeated non-NPCs after battle when their level is no more than 1.25 times yours; rolled for each potential prisoner.

subtalents.name: Healing
subtalents.effect: At battle end, heals all party members for SR * 2 HP, up to 90% HP.

subtalents.name: Treatment
subtalents.effect: At battle end, automatically treats party afflictions up to a severity based on SR: 1 = Minor, 2 = Moderate, 3 = Major.

subtalents.name: Prevention
subtalents.effect: Reduces the party's chance of suffering battle afflictions by SR * 10% of the normal chance. Only the highest Prevention applies.

subtalents.name: Full Swing
subtalents.effect: Without a Shield or Sub-Weapon equipped, increases Scaled Weapon ATK of Swords, Axes, and Spears by SR * 2; doubled for weapons with 20 Weight or more.

modifiers.subject: Scaled Weapon ATK of Swords, Axes, and Spears

subtalents.name: Steady
subtalents.effect: Without a Shield or Sub-Weapon equipped, increases Gun Hit by SR * 2; doubled for Rifle weapons.

subtalents.name: Honor
subtalents.effect: Recover SR * 1 FP when hitting an enemy from their front. Does not apply if the target is knocked down or your party outnumbers theirs.

subtalents.name: Smite
subtalents.effect: Increases Hit by SR * 3 when attacking an enemy from their front. Does not apply if the target is knocked down or your party outnumbers theirs.

subtalents.name: Protector
subtalents.effect: When you trigger Protect, gain SR * 1 Armor and Magic Armor until your next turn.

subtalents.name: Potency
subtalents.effect: Increases Fire ATK by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Efficiency
subtalents.effect: Reduces Nerifian-domain spell FP costs by SR * 3%; only the highest applicable Efficiency applies.

subtalents.name: Scorch
subtalents.effect: Increases the duration of Cinder tiles you create by SR * 1 rounds.

subtalents.name: Ignis
subtalents.effect: Increases success when applying Burn by SR * 3%.

subtalents.name: Potency
subtalents.effect: Increases Ice ATK by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Efficiency
subtalents.effect: Reduces Aquarian-domain spell FP costs by SR * 3%; only the highest applicable Efficiency applies.

subtalents.name: Freeze
subtalents.effect: Increases the duration of Ice Sheet tiles you create by SR * 1 rounds.

subtalents.name: Potency
subtalents.effect: Increases Earth ATK by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Efficiency
subtalents.effect: Reduces Isespian-domain spell FP costs by SR * 3%; only the highest applicable Efficiency applies.

subtalents.name: Magnet
subtalents.effect: Increases the duration of Magnetize statuses you apply by SR * 1 rounds.

subtalents.name: Potency
subtalents.effect: Increases Wind ATK by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Efficiency
subtalents.effect: Reduces Sylphid-domain spell FP costs by SR * 3%; only the highest applicable Efficiency applies.

subtalents.name: Air Shaft
subtalents.effect: Increases the duration of Air Shaft tiles you create by SR * 1 rounds.

subtalents.name: Potency
subtalents.effect: Increases Water ATK by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Efficiency
subtalents.effect: Reduces Aquarian-domain spell FP costs by SR * 3%; only the highest applicable Efficiency applies.

subtalents.name: Flood
subtalents.effect: Increases the duration of Flooded Water tiles you create by SR * 1 rounds.

subtalents.name: Potency
subtalents.effect: Increases Darkness ATK by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Efficiency
subtalents.effect: Reduces Huggessoan-domain spell FP costs by SR * 3%; only the highest applicable Efficiency applies.

subtalents.name: Black Sea
subtalents.effect: Increases the duration of Dark Water tiles you create by SR * 1 rounds.

subtalents.name: Dimness
subtalents.effect: Increases the duration of Darkness tiles you create by SR * 1 rounds.

subtalents.name: Potency
subtalents.effect: Increases Light ATK by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Efficiency
subtalents.effect: Reduces Mercalan-domain spell FP costs by SR * 3%; only the highest applicable Efficiency applies.

subtalents.name: Eternity
subtalents.effect: Increases the duration of Light Shaft tiles you create by SR * 1 rounds.

subtalents.name: Potency
subtalents.effect: Increases Lightning ATK by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Efficiency
subtalents.effect: Reduces Nature-domain spell FP costs by SR * 3%; only the highest applicable Efficiency applies.

subtalents.name: Lowrath
subtalents.effect: Increases the chance of Lightning criticals by SR * 2%.

subtalents.name: Ampage
subtalents.effect: Increases success when applying Interference by SR * 3%.

subtalents.name: Depth
subtalents.effect: Increases maximum FP by SR * 5.

subtalents.name: Absorption
subtalents.effect: Increases FP Regeneration by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Recycle
subtalents.effect: In battle, spells cast by others restore SR * 4% of their FP cost or 3 FP, whichever is higher.

subtalents.name: Whimsy
subtalents.effect: Increases Status Infliction by SR * 2%.

subtalents.name: Efficiency
subtalents.effect: Reduces Enchant-class spell FP costs by SR * 3%; only the highest applicable Efficiency applies.

subtalents.name: Prolong
subtalents.effect: Increases Enchant-class spell status duration by SR * 1 rounds; half effective on enemies.

subtalents.name: Basics
subtalents.effect: Allows you to read and write where appropriate, such as papers and signs.

subtalents.name: Stamina
subtalents.effect: Increases Mental Stamina recovered every hour by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Spellbook
subtalents.effect: With a Tome equipped, increases maximum Skill Pool size by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Balance
subtalents.effect: Reduces Tome Battle Weight by up to SR * 1.5.

subtalents.name: Adaptation
subtalents.effect: Allows you to equip any Tome with Rarity equal to or less than SR * 2.

subtalents.name: Words of Power
subtalents.effect: Reduces the chance that damage breaks an Invocation by SR * 10%; at SR 10, damage can never break one.

subtalents.name: Minor Glyph
subtalents.effect: While invoking, a magical barrier increases Armor and Magic Armor by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Tutor
subtalents.effect: Increases Youkai EXP by SR * 3%; doubled when the Youkai is lower level than you.

subtalents.name: Friendship
subtalents.effect: Increases starting Youkai friendship by SR * 2 and friendship from gifts by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Starsign
subtalents.effect: Adds a selectable Starsign that grants a small statistic and elemental ATK bonus, stronger during its governing months; selection cannot be changed without respeccing.

subtalents.name: Guidance
subtalents.effect: In Space dungeons, increases trap-detection range by SR * 1 tiles; also boosts Hit for 3 rounds by SR after a Star Graph skill.

subtalents.name: Stargazer
subtalents.effect: At night, increases campfire HP/FP recovery by SR * 3% and also increases night vision range.

subtalents.name: Commune
subtalents.effect: At night while outside, allows Commune With Stars.

subtalents.name: Tactics
subtalents.effect: Increases Scaled Weapon ATK by SR and reduces damage from space-originating monsters, such as Spatials, by SR%.

subtalents.name: Divine Sign
subtalents.effect: Blessed and Exorcism weapon basic attacks deal SR * 3 Light damage on hit against enemies they affect.

subtalents.name: Prayer
subtalents.effect: Praying at an altar or religious symbol grants Prayer for SR * 5 rounds across battles and costs Mental Stamina.

subtalents.name: Intervention
subtalents.effect: While Prayer is active, grants an SR * 1% chance that damage taken is reduced by Scaled Faith.

subtalents.name: Delivery
subtalents.effect: Increases the range of most Item skills by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Perfect
subtalents.effect: Increases effectiveness and/or grants bonus effects to some Item skills based on SR.

subtalents.name: Gatherer
subtalents.effect: Increases the chance of collecting alchemy ingredients from plants by SR * 20%.

subtalents.name: Special Stone
subtalents.effect: Magic Stone battle items have an SR * 15% chance not to be consumed; they remain limited to once per battle.

subtalents.name: Perception
subtalents.effect: Allows sensing spirits in an SR-based area; paging shows whether they are malicious.

subtalents.name: Release
subtalents.effect: Allows releasing perceived spirits using Mental Stamina. Success is based on SR and the spirit's page and grants roleplaying EXP; failure can cause negative effects for black spirits.

subtalents.name: Possession
subtalents.effect: Allows a spirit to possess you temporarily up to SR; its page determines the effect. You count as Possessed, and the spirit escapes if you reach 0 HP.

subtalents.name: Performance
subtalents.effect: Allows Performance Tools; listeners can receive up to one beneficial effect that lasts longer the more they listen.

subtalents.name: Potency
subtalents.effect: Increases Sound ATK by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Vocal Training
subtalents.effect: Reduces Song skill FP costs by SR * 3%; only the highest applicable Efficiency applies.

subtalents.name: Plant Song
subtalents.effect: Once per day per plant, a full performance with a Free instrument near farm plants accelerates growth by SR * 2 hours.

subtalents.name: First Move
subtalents.effect: At battle start except back attacks, gain Initiative LV SR * 0.5 for round one, increasing Move by LV; LV and duration are doubled on a back attack.

subtalents.name: Food Supply
subtalents.effect: If hungry at battle end, automatically eats one stocked emergency food. Stock SR * 1; refills at an inn. It gives no roleplaying EXP but restores HP/FP Regeneration like food.

subtalents.name: Just In Case
subtalents.effect: Increases Item Belt size by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Hoarder
subtalents.effect: Increases maximum carrying capacity by SR * 5.

subtalents.name: Hauler
subtalents.effect: Increases maximum Battle Weight by SR * 2.

subtalents.name: Hider
subtalents.effect: Reduces the total number of items dropped on defeat by SR * 15%.

subtalents.name: Keen Eye
subtalents.effect: Increases the range and skill for detecting ground traps, doors, and chests based on SR.

subtalents.name: Solver
subtalents.effect: Decreases Mental Stamina required to recover traps, including your own, by SR * 1, minimum 1.

subtalents.name: Trenchman
subtalents.effect: Decreases hole-digging time by SR * 7% of the shovel's base speed.

subtalents.name: Landmarker
subtalents.effect: After closing a treasure map, marks the treasure spot for you with an X for SR * 5 seconds.

subtalents.name: Knowledge
subtalents.effect: Sets base lock-opening success to SR * 10%, modified by lockpick quality and lock strength.

subtalents.name: Dexterity
subtalents.effect: Decreases time needed for a lockpick attempt by SR * 0.5 seconds.

subtalents.name: Disarm
subtalents.effect: Allows trap disarming and increases success by SR * 20%.

subtalents.name: Failsafe
subtalents.effect: Reduces the chance a failed disarm triggers the trap by SR * 20%; at SR 5, it never triggers accidentally.

subtalents.name: Miner
subtalents.effect: Boosts item-finding success while mining ore veins by SR * 20%.

subtalents.name: Scavenger
subtalents.effect: Boosts the chance of finding wood and food at old campfires by SR * 20%.

subtalents.name: Fieldworker
subtalents.effect: Decreases time to hoe dirt into farm soil by SR * 7% of the hoe's base speed.

subtalents.name: Lumberjack
subtalents.effect: Decreases tree-cutting time by SR * 7% of the axe's base speed.

subtalents.name: Experienced
subtalents.effect: Decreases minor-injury chance while mining, scavenging, hoeing, or woodcutting by SR * 17%.

subtalents.name: Feast
subtalents.effect: Allows Feast Tables using 10 of one food. Food is SR * 10% better and SR * 1 more filling, with 10 + SR * 2 servings; the table is immobile.

subtalents.name: Camp Meal
subtalents.effect: Allows Camp Meals at campfires. Serves 1 + SR * 1 meals, improves quality by SR * 3%, and increases filling duration by SR * 1.

subtalents.name: Butcher
subtalents.effect: Boosts item-finding success while harvesting enemy remains by SR * 20%.

subtalents.name: Sneak
subtalents.effect: When engaging unalerted map monsters, you and your party gain Sneak for SR * 1 rounds; only the highest Sneak applies.

subtalents.name: Plain
subtalents.effect: Hides equipment appearance and names from other players up to SR: 1 Accessories, 2 Legs, 3 Hands/Shields, 4 Torso, 5 Weapons.

subtalents.name: Moneyboot
subtalents.effect: Reduces Murai dropped on defeat by SR * 15%; still somewhat effective for Nagas.
